descripcion.motivo: El producto principal está nítido, bien identificado y permite catalogar con exactitud ingredientes, texturas, salsas y emplatado real.

huecos.plato: sharing sushi board with torched salmon nigiri topped with foie and truffle, spicy tuna uramaki, and toro tartare rolls
huecos.origen: from an upscale modern Japanese sushi bar
huecos.elementos: the curved light wood serving board lined with an elongated green leaf, exactly three seared salmon nigiri glazed and topped with seared foie gras cubes and dark truffle slices, exactly five spicy uramaki rolls coated in speckled light green creamy sauce with white and black sesame seeds, exactly two translucent rice paper rolls topped with chopped pink toro tartare and minced green herbs, and one fresh yellow pansy flower with a dark velvety center; resting entirely on a clean, plain, uniform neutral off-white surface with no props or surrounding tableware
huecos.recuento: Exactly one curved wooden board, three seared salmon nigiri with foie and truffle, five cream-sauced uramaki pieces, two toro tartare rolls, and one yellow flower. Nothing else added.

camara.descripcion: elevated three-quarter studio view showing the entire wooden board entering diagonally from the bottom-left toward the center, leaving ample clean negative space in the upper right, the entire board and food fully within the frame without touching any edge

huecos.ideaGrafica: the whole wooden sushi board positioned boldly in the lower-left two thirds, floating with clean contours and soft contact shadows, guiding diagonal perspective toward the upper-right corner reserved for future bold brand typography
huecos.luz: bright, even commercial studio lighting with crisp, soft-edged contact shadows underneath, specular glints on the torched salmon glaze and glossy tartare, clean uniform isolation background for seamless cut-out
huecos.colorDominante: vibrant warm salmon orange and creamy pistachio green as the sole saturated accents against a clean neutral canvas

decisiones: Familia F3 (Recorte sobre color pop): La referencia elegida (ref-pin-34) requiere que el producto quede totalmente aislado y recortado para recibir fondo de color plano y titular en la zona superior derecha; por eso se pide un fondo neutro liso, sin atrezo y con todo el plato contenido en el encuadre sin cortes.

Cambio radical de toma: La foto original era un picado a 55° cerrado y cortado por tres esquinas con fondo caótico. Se cambia a 40° tres cuartos con giro de 45° y objetivo de 70 mm a f/5.6 para tener nitidez en toda la tabla y un contorno limpio que facilite el recorte profesional.

Cero inventiva: Se conservan exactamente las piezas reales identificadas (3 nigiris con foie y trufa, 5 uramakis con salsa verde, 2 rollos de toro y 1 flor amarilla sobre la tabla curvada real), descartando objetos ajenos a la comida.
